hero_kpi_rationale: Oil and gas production is the primary indicator of ConocoPhillips' operational activity and performance in the energy sector.

kpis.name: Oil and Gas Production
kpis.explanation: Volume of oil and gas produced by the company.
kpis.description: Production is a key indicator of the company's operational activity.
kpis.signal: Production increased by 20% in 2025 (an additional 388 MBOED).

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow is a key indicator of financial health and cash generation.
kpis.signal: Operating cash flow reached $19.8 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Capital Investments
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures made by the company for its projects.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect the company's commitment to growth and production maintenance.
kpis.signal: Capital expenditures amounted to $12.6 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Company's net debt level after cash deduction.
kpis.description: Debt level is a key indicator of balance sheet strength and financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Number of Employees
kpis.explanation: Number of full-time and full-time equivalent employees.
kpis.description: Headcount reflects the size of the organization and strategic changes.
kpis.signal: Headcount decreased by 2% in 2025 following restructuring.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of the company's assets.
kpis.description: Total assets reflect the company's asset base following the acquisition of Marathon Oil.
kpis.signal: Total assets amounted to $122 billion as of December 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures committed to production and development projects.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect strategic investments in operating and development projects.
kpis.signal: Capital expenditures amounted to $12.6 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Dividend Paid
kpis.explanation: Dividend distributed to the company's shareholders.
kpis.description: The regular dividend is a key component of the shareholder return policy.
kpis.signal: The regular dividend amounted to $4.0 billion in 2025, with an 8% increase in the per-share rate to 84 cents.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount of shares repurchased by the company from shareholders.
kpis.description: Share repurchases are a key component of the capital return policy to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Share repurchases amounted to $5.0 billion in 2025, bringing the cumulative total to $39.3 billion since 2016.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's hydrocarbon production activities present significant environmental risks, including GHG emissions. The company has committed to emission intensity reduction targets, but their achievement is subject to risks and could prove costly. (1) Position in the 10-K: Item 1A, (2) Language intensity: high, (3) Context vs N-1: stable, (4) Category weighting: high

risks.title: Geopolitical and Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: Commodity price volatility, geopolitical tensions, conflicts, and fluctuations in global demand directly impact profitability and cash flows. The company operates in 14 countries, increasing geopolitical exposure. (1) Position in the 10-K: Item 1A Business Environment, (2) Language intensity: high, (3) Context vs N-1: increased, (4) Category weighting: high

risks.title: Regulatory and Energy Transition Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the energy sector, including environmental and climate requirements. The global energy transition poses long-term risks to the business model. (1) Position in the 10-K: Item 1A, (2) Language intensity: high, (3) Context vs N-1: stable, (4) Category weighting: high

risks.title: Marathon Oil Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: Although the integration of Marathon Oil is largely complete in 2025 and has generated over $1 billion in synergies, residual integration risks remain, including cultural management and the realization of additional expected synergies. (1) Position in the 10-K: Item 1 Management Discussion, (2) Language intensity: medium, (3) Context vs N-1: moderate, (4) Category weighting: medium
